text.card: TOI-2092 b crosses its star every 4.3 days and is 3.0 times as wide as Earth, found in 2026.
text.introduction: TOI-2092 b transits TOI-2092 every 4.3 days and is 3.0 times as wide as Earth. Orbit and size follow Lafarga et al. 2026's fit, the archive's default.
